description: This file defines the class OA_Admin_UI_Model_EntityBreadcrumbSegment, which models a segment of an entity breadcrumb used in the header of the admin UI in the Revive Adserver project. It includes properties and methods for managing entity labels, names, URLs, CSS classes, and entity maps.

classes.name: OA_Admin_UI_Model_EntityBreadcrumbSegment
classes.description: A model describing a part of entity breadcrumb shown in header.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the breadcrumb segment with optional label, name, CSS class, and URL.

methods.name: getCssClass
methods.description: Returns the CSS class indicating the entity type icon.

methods.name: getEntityLabel
methods.description: Returns the user-visible label for the entity type.

methods.name: getUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL for the entity page.

methods.name: setCssClass
methods.description: Sets the CSS class for the entity type icon.

methods.name: setEntityLabel
methods.description: Sets the label for the entity type.

methods.name: setUrl
methods.description: Sets the URL for the entity page.

methods.name: getEntityName
methods.description: Returns the name of the entity.

methods.name: setEntityName
methods.description: Sets the name of the entity.

methods.name: getHtmlName
methods.description: Returns the HTML name used for form submission.

methods.name: setHtmlName
methods.description: Sets the HTML name for form submission.

methods.name: getEntityMap
methods.description: Returns the map of entity IDs to entity names and URLs.

methods.name: setEntityMap
methods.description: Sets the entity map and sorts it by name.

methods.name: orderEntitiesByNameAsc
methods.description: Protected method to order entities by name in ascending order.
